answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, thus paying the summit bond on all of them and exposing each to the forge slash. Because the shale audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 9 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A 410 account operation therefore ties up 22 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
